content.rendered:
UPSSSC Telegram Group Link

Full details of UPSSSC are Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission. To conduct Civil Service Examinations in the State of Uttar Pradesh.

The government has set up the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission. The UPSSSC organization conducts various examinations within the state of Uttar Pradesh.

The examinations conducted by this UPSSSC system are Uttar Pradesh Auxiliary Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) Junior Assistant Examination, Conductor Examination, Stenographer Examination, Clerk, Forest Guard, Boring Technician, Lakbal and Pharmacist.

The age limit for writing these examinations is 18 to 40 years. Educational Qualification for UPSSSC Exam Must be a graduate of a recognized University and hold a certificate. Only the people of Uttar Pradesh can write this exam.

Join the telegram team at Keeley to download these UPSSSC exam dates, exam results, and UPSSSC exam books and online class videos for free.
